children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “base acres for peanuts” means the number of acres assigned to a farm pursuant to section 7952 of this title, as in effect on September 30, 2007, subject to any adjustment under section 8752 of this title.

children.heading: Covered commodities
children.text: The term “base acres”, with respect to a covered commodity, has the meaning given the term in section 8711 of this title.

tree.heading: Counter-cyclical payment
tree.text: The term “counter-cyclical payment” means a payment made to producers on a farm under section 8754 1 of this title.

tree.heading: Direct payment
tree.text: The term “direct payment” means a direct payment made to producers on a farm under section 8753 1 of this title.

tree.heading: Effective price
tree.text: The term “effective price” means the price calculated by the Secretary under section 8754 1 of this title for peanuts to determine whether counter-cyclical payments are required to be made under that section for a crop year.

tree.heading: Payment acres
tree.text: The term “payment acres” means, in the case of direct payments and counter-cyclical payments—

children.text: except as provided in subparagraph (B), 85 percent of the base acres of peanuts on a farm on which direct payments or counter-cyclical payments are made; and
in the case of direct payments for each of the 2009 through 2011 crop years, 83.3 percent of the base acres for peanuts on a farm on which direct payments are made.

tree.heading: Payment yield
tree.text: The term “payment yield” means the yield established for direct payments and the yield established for counter-cyclical payments under section 7952 of this title, as in effect on September 30, 2007, for a farm for peanuts.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “producer” means an owner, operator, landlord, tenant, or sharecropper that shares in the risk of producing a crop on a farm and is entitled to share in the crop available for marketing from the farm, or would have shared had the crop been produced.

children.heading: Hybrid seed
children.text: In determining whether a grower of hybrid seed is a producer, the Secretary shall—
not take into consideration the existence of a hybrid seed contract; and
ensure that program requirements do not adversely affect the ability of the grower to receive a payment under this subchapter.
the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico; and
any other territory or possession of the United States.

tree.heading: Target price
tree.text: The term “target price” means the price per ton of peanuts used to determine the payment rate for counter-cyclical payments.

tree.heading: United States
tree.text: The term “United States”, when used in a geographical sense, means all of the States.

notes.text: References in TextSection 8754 of this title, referred to in pars. (2) and (4), was repealed by Pub. L. 113–79, title I, § 1102(a), Feb. 7, 2014, 128 Stat. 658. Section 8753 of this title, referred to in par. (3), was repealed by Pub. L. 113–79, title I, § 1101, Feb. 7, 2014, 128 Stat. 658.
Codification Pub. L. 110–234 and Pub. L. 110–246 enacted identical sections. Pub. L. 110–234 was repealed by section 4(a) of Pub. L. 110–246.

Effective DateEnactment of this section and repeal of Pub. L. 110–234 by Pub. L. 110–246 effective May 22, 2008, the date of enactment of Pub. L. 110–234, see section 4 of Pub. L. 110–246, set out as a note under section 8701 of this title.
